# FDG7063

> CONSIDER the Try Pattern for members that might throw exceptions in common scenarios to avoid performance problems related to exceptions.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.5.2 The Try Pattern.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether a member throws in common scenarios is judgment. CA1854 and CA1864 are not mapped (see FDG7004).

## From the book

> **Jeffrey Richter:** I like this guideline a lot. It solves the race-condition problem and the performance problem. Besides `DateTime.TryParse`, the `Dictionary` class has a `TryGetValue` method.
